verdict.rationale: Figma's Plugin API docs (figma-docs-8, -32, -36, -50) confirm read/write access, custom UI, and event-driven plugin execution, and figma-docs-11/18 describe distribution and workflow customization; figma-probe-1 confirms an indexed llms.txt developer doc set covering Plugin API, Widgets, etc. Typings are implied by TypeScript-based plugin API docs and the sibling REST API TypeScript spec (figma-docs-46), though no plugin-specific typings/sample repo citation is given directly. Missing for 10: explicit citation of a plugin-specific TypeScript typings package/sample repo (e.g., figma-plugin-typings on GitHub) and independent hands-on developer accounts building/distributing a plugin.
